text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki, soon you will conquer the world. 
And once you do—next, I shall ride you all 
the way into outer space!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Pearl-san, what is the matter, yes?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Japan, France, and America. Once I conquer 
the world, there will be nowhere left on 
this Earth to aim for.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So I shall board the shuttle known as you 
and blast off into outer space. And in my 
hands, I'll claim those pearls known as 
stars!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Once you become a world champion, you 
should definitely come back here, 
Pearl-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mama used to say. What you're reaching for 
isn't over the rainbow. It's always right 
by your side.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The universe Pearl-san aims for is right 
beside Tracen Academy, yes. That is the 
place to run...
